questions.question: In an examination, Gopal secured 15% more marks than Asha, and Asha secured 10% more marks than Sachin. How much per cent more marks did Gopal secure than Sachin?
questions.solution:
Given:

Marks scored by Gopal = 15% more than Asha

Marks scored by Asha = 10% more than Sachin

Concept Used:

Percentage Marks Scored = Required Percentage × Total Marks

Calculation:

⇒ Let the marks scored by Sachin be x.

⇒ Marks scored by Asha = x + 10% of x

⇒ Marks scored by Asha = x+(x)/(10)=(11x)/(10)

⇒ Marks scored by Gopal = (11x)/(10)+(15)/(100)×(11x)/(10)

⇒ Marks scored by Gopal = (11x)/(10)+(33x)/(200)=(220x+33x)/(200)=(253x)/(200)

⇒ Difference between Gopal and Sachin marks = (253x)/(200)-x=(53x)/(200)

⇒ Percentage marks Gopal scored more than Sachin = (frac{53x)/(200)}{{(x)/(1)}}×100

⇒ Percentage marks Gopal scored more than Sachin = (53)/(200)×100=26.5 %

Hence, Gopal scored 26.5 % more marks than Sachin.

questions.question: Pranjal takes twice as much time as Vikram or thrice as much time as Ashwin to finish a piece of work. Working together, they can finish the work in 6 days. Vikram can do the work alone in:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Time taken by Pranjal = Twice as much as Vikram

Time taken by Pranjal = Thrice as much as Ashwin

Time taken to finish work together = 6 days

**Calculation:**

⇒ Let Pranjal take x days to complete the work.

⇒ So, Vikram takes (x)/(2) and Ashwin takes (x)/(3) days to complete the work.

⇒ According to the question, all working together

⇒ Then, ((1)/(x)+(2)/(x)+(3)/(x) )=(1)/(6)

⇒ (6)/(x)=(1)/(6)

⇒ x = 36 days

⇒ Time taken by Vikram to complete the work = (x)/(2)=(36)/(2)=18 days

**Hence, Vikram can complete the work alone in 18 days.**

**Short trick:**

**Formula used:**

Efficiency = Total unit/No. of days

Time is inversely proportional to efficiency

**Calculation:**

As , we know that time is inversely proportional to efficiency 

So, let the efficiency of pranjal be x 

Then efficiency of vikram = 2x

Efficiency of Ashwin = 3x

Total efficiencies = x + 2x + 3x = 6x 

Total days taken to work together = 6 

Total unit = 6x × 6 = 36x

Now, vikram can do the work in = 36x/2x = 18

**Hence, vikram can do the work in 18 days .**

questions.question: If 60% of a number is equal to three-fourth of another number, what is the ratio of the first number to the second number?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

60% of a number = Three-fourth of another number

**Calculation:**

⇒ Let the first number be x and another number be y.

⇒ So, 60% of x = (3)/(4)times y

⇒ (60)/(100)times x=(3)/(4)y

⇒ (x)/(y)=(frac{3)/(4)}{(3)/(5)}=(3×5)/(4×3)

⇒ (x)/(y)=(5)/(4)=5:4

**Hence, the ratio of the first number to the second number is 5 : 4**

questions.question: It is given that the average of 19 numbers is 8.5. If one number with value 63 was entered incorrectly as 25, then the corrected average is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Average of 19 numbers = 8.5

Correct Number = 63

Incorrect Number = 25

**Concept Used:**

Average = Sum of all values ÷ Number of values

**Calculation:**

Total sum of 19 numbers = 19 × 8.5 = 161.5

Removal of Incorrect Number = 161.5 – 25 = 136.5

Now, After adding the correct number

Total sum of 19 numbers = 136.5 + 63 = 199.5

⇒ Corrected Average of 19 numbers = (199.5)/(19)=10.5

**Hence, the corrected average of the 19 numbers is 10.5**

questions.question: The volume of a sphere is 38808 cm³. What is its surface area (in cm²)? (Take π = 22/7)
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Volume of sphere = 38808 cm³

**Concept Used:**

Volume of sphere = (4)/(3)π r³

Surface Area of sphere = 4πr²

**Calculation:**

⇒ (4)/(3)π r³=38808

⇒ (4)/(3)× (22)/(7)× r³=38808

⇒ r³=(38808× 21)/(88)

⇒ r³ = 9261

⇒ r = 21 cm

Now, the Surface Area of the sphere = 4× (22)/(7)× 21× 21

⇒ 4 × 66 × 21 = 5544 cm²

**Hence, the surface area of a sphere is 5544 cm².**

questions.question: Which of the following numbers is divisible by 360?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Divisor = 360

**Concept Used:**

Divisible by 9 = Sum of all digits of numbers divisible by 9

**Calculation:**

360 can be expressed in the form of factors 5 × 8 × 9

For numbers to be divisible by 360, it should be divisible by 9 also.

⇒ 171720 = 1 + 7 + 1 + 7 + 2 + 0 = 18

So, it is divisible by 9

⇒ 176600 = 1 + 7 + 6 + 6 + 0 + 0 = 20

So, it is not divisible by 9

⇒ 166200 = 1 + 6 + 6 + 2 + 0 + 0 = 15

So, it is not divisible by 9

⇒ 171080 = 1 + 7 + 1 + 0 + 8 + 0 = 17

So, it is not divisible by 9

**Hence, the number which is divisible by 360 is 171720**

questions.question: A library has an average of 330 visitors on Sundays and 240 on the other days. Find the average of the number of visitors per day in a month of 30 days, beginning with a Saturday.
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Average visitors on Sundays = 330

Average visitors on the other days = 240

Total days in the month = 30

**Concept Used:**

Average = Total Sum of Values ÷ Number of values

**Calculation:**

Starting with Saturday as the first day

Number of Sundays in the month = 5

So, Number of visitors on Sundays in the month

⇒ 330 × 5 = 1650

Number of visitors on the other days = 25 × 240 = 6000

Total visitors in the month

⇒ 6000 + 1650 = 7650

Then, Average visitors per day = (7650)/(30)=255

**Hence, the number of visitors per day in a month is 255**

questions.question: Rajesh purchased a machine for Rs. 5,000 and paid Rs. 250 for its transportation. If he sells the machine for Rs. 5,075, what is his percentage profit or loss? (Correct to two decimal places)
questions.solution:
**Given:**

CP of machine = Rs. 5,000

Transportation cost = Rs. 250 

SP = Rs. 5,075

**Formula used:**

% profit = (SP-CP)/(CP) times 100 

% loss = (CP-SP)/(CP)times 100

**Calculation:**

Total amount paid by Rajesh = CP of machine + Transportation of machine

⇒ Rs. 5,000 + Rs. 250 = Rs. 5250

Selling Price = Rs. 5,075

As it can be noticed that CP > SP

⇒ Hence **it is a loss**

% loss = (5250-5075)/(5250)times 100

% loss = 3.33 %

**Rajesh is bearing a loss of 3.33 %**

questions.question: A sum of money was invested at 10% interest per year, compounded half-yearly for 18 months. If the amount payable on maturity was Rs. 83,349, what was the sum invested?
questions.solution:
Given:

The sum invested at 10%

The sum invested compounded half yearly for 18 months

The amount payable on maturity was Rs. 83349

Formula used:

C.I. = P(1+ (R)/(100))^T

where C.I.= Amount payable on maturity

P= Amount invested or Principle

R= Rate of interest

T= Time Period

Calculation:

When the amount is invested for compounded half yearly, then the time period got doubled and rate of interest got halved

Time period= 18 mon x 2 = 36mon or 3 years

New rate of interest= 10% / 2 = 5%

According to the formula,

⇒ C.I = P(1+ (R)/(100))^T 

⇒ 83349=P(1+(5)/(100))³ 

⇒ 83349=P(1+(1)/(20))³

 ⇒ 83349=P×(21)/(20)×(21)/(20)×(21)/(20)

⇒ 83349×(20)/(21)×(20)/(21)×(20)/(21)=P 

⇒ 9 × 8000 = 72000

**T**he amount invested for 18 months is Rs. 72,000
